summary: Iteration 3 tested 3 new features (Streak Rewards, Interview Recording, Voice Read-Aloud) + regression. Backend: extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py with TestStreakRewards (2 tests: 7-day streak seeded via pymongo -> streak=7, bonus_xp=100, Unstoppable badge earned, +100 in DNA total_xp, /badges shows earned; fresh user with no history -> bonus_xp=0, streak<7, no streak7 badge) and TestInterviewRecording (2 tests: start+answer -> save with fake webm -> {id, avg_score, has_video:true}; GET /interview/records lists it with qa; GET /interview/video/{id}?auth=<JWT> returns 200 bytes; unauth 401; save without video -> has_video:false). Full pytest suite: 33/33 passed in ~18s. Frontend: seeded 6-day activity in learning_dna for fresh user via pymongo, then loaded /dashboard -> daily-challenge card, submitted -> daily-result rendered 'streak-bonus' element with text 'Unstoppable! +100 bonus XP for a 7-day streak', badge toast 'Badge unlocked: Unstoppable' visible, 7-day streak shown; Tutor autoread-toggle ON -> 2 /api/tts POST calls after streaming completes for message, OFF -> 0 TTS calls; manual per-message Listen (speak-btn-N) still fires /api/tts. Interview UI: /interview shows interview-history before start; started with mic+camera permissions granted, recorded with MediaRecorder, submitted 5 answers, interview-done rendered with 'Saved to your history', restart brought back to history containing new record-<id>, expanding it revealed record-video-<id> with correct src=/api/interview/video/<id>?auth=<token> and Q/A feedback per question (video element visible in browser with recorded webm).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1094 lines. Object storage, interview save/records/video, daily, badges, quiz, chat, etc. all live in one module. Strongly recommend splitting into routers (auth, chat, tts, stt, quiz, badges, interview, interview_media, daily, friends, catalog).

GET /api/interview/video/{record_id} accepts auth via query param but does not restrict the token TTL check — a leaked JWT lets anyone playback until token exp (30 days). Consider generating short-lived per-record signed URLs.
put_object/get_object are sync requests wrapped via asyncio.to_thread — fine, but no size limit enforced on interview_save uploads. Add a max_size (e.g. 200MB) guard against DoS.
Interview.js uses `BACKEND + res.data.url` for TTS audio: same brittle string concat as noted last iteration; still not fixed but not blocking.
record-video-<id> src embeds the JWT in URL; browser history & referrer headers can leak. Consider blob URL fetched with Authorization header + object URL for playback.

evaluate_badges awards streak7 XP via a direct $inc on learning_dna; if two concurrent daily submits raced it could double-award. Idempotent by 'existing badge check' but the $inc happens outside a transaction. Low-risk for MVP.
test_credentials: ravi_test@example.com / pass1234; iteration also created uistreak_* / streak_* / nostreak_* throwaway users
seed_data_creation: Registered a fresh throwaway user and seeded learning_dna.activity with the 6 previous UTC dates (each value=2) via pymongo directly on test_database, so that the current-day daily/submit crosses the 7-day threshold and triggers the Unstoppable badge + 100 bonus XP. This was done both in the pytest fixture and in a one-off /tmp/seed_streak.py used by the browser UI test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression: `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v` (33 tests, ~18s). To manually test streak-7 UI/API: register a fresh user, then `db.learning_dna.updateOne({user_id:UID}, {$set:{activity:{<6 prior YYYY-MM-DD>:2, ...}}}, {upsert:true})` and POST /api/daily/submit. NEVER reuse a user that already submitted today — daily is one-per-user-per-day. For interview video test, `TestInterviewRecording` uses a small fake webm blob; real MediaRecorder from Chromium fake-camera also uploads/plays successfully in the UI. Object storage is initialised at backend startup via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY and confirmed working. The /api/interview/video/{id} endpoint accepts JWT via query param `auth=` because <video src> can't send Authorization header.
